description: The plot illustrates the relationship between Average Lagging (AL) and BLEU scores for different consistency methods. The x-axis is labeled "Average Lagging (AL)", has a linear scale, spans from 0 to 8, is measured in units of AL, and has tick labels at integer values. The y-axis is labeled "BLEU", has a linear scale, spans from 20 to 32, and has tick labels at intervals of 2. A purple line with square markers represents Consistency-CE, starting at approximately (0, 22) and increasing to approximately (8, 31). A dark blue line with square markers represents Inconsistency-CE, starting at approximately (0, 25) and increasing to approximately (8, 31). A light blue dashed line with square markers represents Inconsistency-CE-MP, transitioning from approximately (0, 21) to approximately (8, 30). A red line with star markers represents Consistency-Bi, beginning at approximately (0, 26) and rising to approximately (8, 32).
